purpose: 過去の生成指示。現在の採用画像・実装状態・人の承認を示すものではない。

entries.name: 破裂弾
entries.prompt:
COLOR-ONLY EDIT of the supplied practical 破裂弾 (burst-bomb) game item. LOCK every pixel-level design decision: exact shape, silhouette, orientation, proportions, all parts and their attachment, handles/straps/caps/nozzles/fuse, seams, outline thickness, large faceted flat planes, existing regular manga dots, framing and transparent alpha. Do NOT redraw into new geometry, do NOT add/remove any component or texture.
ONLY recolor to calm WARM RETRO LOW-SATURATION palette matching cream/rust/dusty teal/dusty gold illustrated adventure gear. Existing color is too much like vivid primary colors. REQUIRED: Change vivid primary red body to MUTED RED OCHRE / RUST #A86553, lit #BE8A6C, shadow #844B43. Preserve gray bands but warm gray, no saturated scarlet.
Preserve bright readable light planes and subdued darker planes; low contrast, no overall dark filter. Glass neutral whites should be warm pale cream-gray, metal neutral warm gray, leather earthy muted brown. Keep black ink and manga dots clearly black. No new shine, gradients, grunge, background, text or shadow. Keep actual transparency. The change in saturation/color must be visibly obvious at300px; no vivid primary patches left. The whole item stays exactly the same physical practical object.
